name: bash_output
description:
Retrieves the output and exit status of a background command previously started by the Bash or PowerShell tool with run_in_background=true.

Deprecated escape hatch: prefer waiting for the automatic background-shell completion notification. Pass the `shell_id` returned by the background tool call only when you explicitly need a manual recovery read. While the command is still running, the result reports that it is in progress and includes output captured so far; do not repeatedly call this tool while status is running. Once it has exited, the result carries the full captured stdout/stderr plus the exit code.

inputs.name: shell_id
inputs.description: The shell_id returned by a Bash call made with run_in_background=true.
